body: This should have been fixed with this commit: 1ab492394c
I'm using the current 2.1.\* branch, but the error occurs. The commit is included in my code, but it doesn't fix the issue.
For the record, this error does not only occur with pdf files. I reproduced it with zip files.

@romainneutron you should be able to reproduce it with any kind of file. 
Another option would be to remove the 'Cache-Control' header for 1.0 protocol but I'm not sure that's very good nor that it solves the problem. Can someone test please?

It seems that the `pragma: no-cache` is also responsible for failing the download. Because as soon as I removed it, there were no problems in IE 8.
Removing for 1.0 protocol will not help, because IE 8 uses the 1.1 version.
Right, I'm not sure how to fix it without IE < 9 detection. Any suggestion?

Well, in my case, I solved it with a pragma: public header as described
here
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/1920781/what-does-the-http-header-pragma-public-mean

I did not notice any side effect, but I'm not http header expert

Romain

On 16 janv. 2013, at 20:33, Florin Patan notifications@github.com wrote:

For the record, I'm using this hack for more than a year and half on
production apps, with 50% IE (mixed versions).

I'm not detecting browser, so I send the header for every download.

No side effect seen.
